name: OREGON ELECTRONICS
old_description: Welcome to Oregon Electronics - Your local source for electronics parts
about:
Oregon Electronics operates from Eugene, Oregon, where it was founded in 2011. The company remains privately held, though its ownership structure has not been publicly disclosed, and no founders are named in available sources.

The business functions as a broad-line distributor of electronic components, carrying more than 100,000 unique part numbers that range from passive components and connectors to development boards, robotics kits, and 3D printers. It is an authorized distributor for FlashForge USA, selling the manufacturer’s desktop 3D printers such as the Dreamer dual-extrusion model. In addition to stocked inventory, Oregon Electronics offers custom cable assembly built to customer specifications, drawing on what it describes as over 25 years of combined staff experience in cable fabrication. A brick-and-mortar store in Eugene provides walk-in access during weekday and Saturday hours.

The customer base spans educational institutions, architectural firms, engineering consultancies, design studios, and the wider consumer and prosumer market that FlashForge targets. The company also supplies robotics hobbyists and makers through its robotics parts category.

Oregon Electronics emphasizes its deep inventory, the ability to special-order items not in stock, and its custom cable service as key differentiators. The firm highlights its experienced staff and local presence as reasons customers choose it for both off-the-shelf components and tailored cable solutions.

name: OSH Cut
old_description: Get 2-day delivery throughout the US for less than the typical price of ground shipping.
about:
OSH Cut operates from Spanish Fork, Utah, as an on-demand metal fabrication shop. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources.

The shop runs a digital-first production line centered on laser cutting, tube laser cutting, bending, tapping, and flat finishing. Cutting is performed on 10 kW Trumpf 3030 fiber lasers, a 7 kW Trumpf 7000 tube laser, and an 8 kW Mazak Optiplex, all driven by in-house software that ties the online quoting and DFM engine directly to the machine controllers. Deburring uses a 120-grit wide-belt sander and graining a 240-grit belt. Bending capacity reaches 3/4 inch thickness in steel, stainless, aluminum, and copper; tapping covers 6-32 through 1 1/2-6 and M3 through M36. Powder coating is also offered. Standard cutting tolerance is ±0.005 inch.

Customers span aerospace, medical devices, astronomy, and the FIRST Robotics FRC community, alongside general prototyping and low-volume production buyers. The platform accepts a wide range of CAD files—including STEP, SLDPRT, DXF, and SVG—and ships to all 50 states via parcel or LTL freight.

OSH Cut emphasizes its instant quoting app with real-time DFM feedback and forming simulation, which lets users upload complex geometries that other vendors reject. The company advertises two-day delivery across the United States and positions its software-driven workflow as the primary differentiator.

name: OTC Medical
about:
OTC Medical operates from Frankfort, Maine, as a veteran-owned and RN-founded medical supply company. The business was established by a registered nurse who understood patient and caregiver needs, and it is structured as a veteran-owned enterprise; a founding year is not disclosed.

The company distributes home healthcare equipment and caregiver supplies, including mobility aids such as canes, walkers, and wheelchairs; bathroom safety products like commodes, shower chairs, and grab bars; and diagnostic devices such as blood pressure monitors, thermometers, pulse oximeters, and glucose meters. It carries brands including Drive Medical, Medline, Moen, Omron, Vicks, Zacurate, and Ascensia. Orders are fulfilled through an e-commerce platform with same-day personal delivery available in select Maine zip codes and standard shipping across the United States.

Customers include patients, families, caregivers, and healthcare professionals throughout Maine and nationwide. The product assortment is curated for safe, independent living at home.

The founder’s clinical background and the veteran ownership structure are cited as the foundation for a service model focused on dependable delivery and product selection.

name: Oak City Customs
old_description: (Pre-Built) Poplar Live Edge Tabletop #PB164 106" x 39" - 40" x 2.0"
about:
Oak City Customs, founded in 2015, operates from Zebulon, North Carolina. The company manufactures all its custom furniture and fabrication at its facility there. No founders or ownership details are disclosed.

The shop produces a wide range of custom wood and metal furnishings, including dining tables, conference tables, epoxy river tables, coffee tables, waterfall tables, wood countertops, shelves, mantels, bench seats, and wood panels. It also supplies live edge wood slabs in species such as red oak, white oak, soft maple, walnut, parota, cedar, sycamore, poplar, sapele, ash, sweet gum, and pine, as well as reclaimed bourbon barrel wood. Table bases include teak, Guayaquil, and Guachipelin root designs. The facility handles both woodworking and metal fabrication, with capabilities for epoxy resin casting and custom design.

The company serves commercial and residential customers. Commercial clients include fire departments (firehouse logo tables), fraternities and sororities, and businesses needing conference tables and partitioned workstations. Residential buyers purchase dining sets, coffee tables, and outdoor furniture such as modular garden planters and poolside cabanas.

Oak City Customs emphasizes domestic production, stating that all custom products are manufactured at its Zebulon facility. Its "From Tree To Table®" branding and "Urban Lumber Process" video highlight a focus on sourcing and processing urban lumber into finished pieces.

In-house capabilities include welding, forming, plating, painting, and silk-screening, allowing finished parts to leave the facility complete. The company emphasizes that no job is too small, accommodating both one-off prototypes and larger production quantities.

about:
Odyssey Electronics operates from Livonia, Michigan. The company has provided printed circuit board assembly services for more than 35 years, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

The company runs two production facilities totaling more than 32,000 square feet, equipped with five surface-mount technology lines. Its in-house capabilities span surface mount assembly, thru-hole assembly, wave and selective soldering, automated optical inspection, X-ray verification, in-circuit testing, boundary scan, functional testing, conformal coating, potting, and turn-key assembly. Odyssey handles projects ranging from low-volume prototype runs of ten boards to high-volume manufacturing of ten thousand units or more.

Odyssey serves a broad set of industries including military electronics, medical, alternative energy, audio and video, industrial and commercial, telematics and telecommunications, life science, and LED lighting. Customers range from engineers developing early prototypes to global brands requiring full-scale production across multiple continents.

The company emphasizes a single-roof model that reduces handoffs and centralizes quality control. Its facilities are ISO 9001:2015 certified and meet IPC-A-610 standards, with 100 percent inspection including automated optical inspection and X-ray at multiple production stages. Odyssey is also ITAR registered, supporting defense programs with documented traceability and compliance.

name: Oem Experts
old_description: To create maximum revenue opportunity for our clients, by offering only the best products with a better value through creative and transparent global product merchandising.
about:
OEM Experts operates from Brooklyn, New York, and was founded in 2005. The company is built on a team of professionals with over 25 years of experience in the wholesale wireless business, having worked with major manufacturers and chain stores. While ownership details are not publicly specified, the business emphasizes relationship-driven partnerships and networks to negotiate favorable pricing for its customers.

The company specializes in the wholesale distribution of major-brand cell phone accessories, including car chargers, Bluetooth headsets, Bluetooth speakers, and backup batteries. It sources closeout, liquidation, and customer-return inventory, offering flexible purchasing options such as drop shipping, light bulk lots, palletized orders, and full truckloads. Orders are processed for shipment within 24 to 48 business hours, and the company provides dedicated support for online sellers, including professional photography, keyword research, and listing optimization at no extra cost.

OEM Experts serves a broad range of buyers in the wireless ecosystem: brokers, small to large wholesalers, master agents, Amazon and eBay sellers, brick-and-mortar retail chains, exporters shipping to South America, Central America, Europe, and Asia, as well as refurbishers, MVNOs, and insurance companies needing parts such as LCDs, charging ports, and OEM packaging.

The company positions itself as a partner that turns inventory challenges into profitable opportunities, emphasizing authentic product, market protection for resellers, and creative global merchandising. It offers net 30- to 60-day terms up to $50,000, a buyback program for obsolete stock, and bilingual account representatives tailored to regional export markets.

name: Off Road Warehouse
about:
Off Road Warehouse operates a retail and service location at 6545 S. Decatur Boulevard in Las Vegas, Nevada. The store functions as part of the 4 Wheel Parts network, which operates over 40 performance centers nationwide. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed for this specific outlet.

The facility provides installation and maintenance services for off-road and automotive vehicles. Offerings include tire mounting and balancing for 35- to 40-inch wheels, suspension inspection, installation and repair, wheel alignments, lifting and lowering suspension kit installation, shock and strut replacement, 4x4 preventative maintenance inspections, premium synthetic oil changes, brake service and upgrade installation, battery replacement with charging system testing, gear and locker installation, hitch and towing accessory installation, load assist installation, and interior and exterior accessory fitting. The location leverages the broader network’s inventory, described as the largest drivetrain inventory nationwide.

Customers include off-road enthusiasts and general automotive owners of passenger cars, trucks, and SUVs with gas or diesel engines. The store carries products from brands such as RIGID Industries and other major aftermarket manufacturers, serving both retail consumers and commercial fleets seeking same-day service.

The company emphasizes same-day service on most jobs, free inspections for suspension, alignment, and brakes, and factory-trained technicians at every location as key differentiators. The origin story or specific founding mission for this outlet is not stated in available sources.

name: Ohio Wire Form Spring
old_description: Since 1947, Ohio Wire Form & Spring has been committed to providing products that meet our customer’s demands with excellent customer service.
about:
Ohio Wire Form & Spring has operated from Columbus, Ohio since its founding in 1947. The company began as a wire forming shop and has grown into a full-service manufacturer of custom wire forms, springs, and related components.

The shop produces a range of wire-based products including custom wire forms, torsion, extension, compression, and coil springs, hooks, racks, and rod-formed parts. Processes encompass four-slide forming, CNC machine optimization, and in-house tooling and design. The company handles projects from prototype to mass production with no minimum order quantity, serving both small inventors and large multinational firms.

Customers span medical device manufacturers, automotive suppliers such as Dana, outdoor recreation brands including BB Waterfowl and Tomahawk Live Trap, industrial control firms like Saginaw Control Engineering, and lighting companies such as Acuity Brands. The company also works directly with entrepreneurs and inventors to develop concepts from initial sketches.

Ohio Wire Form emphasizes eliminating minimum order requirements and providing in-house tooling to reduce costs and lead times. Its stated focus is on helping inventors and entrepreneurs turn ideas into production parts while maintaining a commitment to customer service and American manufacturing.
